items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and authorize no discretionary spend, budget commitments, monetization expansion, forecasts, requeues, or production work. Revenue evidence supports only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly limits are blank. Minimum measurement: a dated cost ledger reconciled to site/content identifiers and the revenue window, experiment-level incremental outcomes, and owner-approved spending limits. Continue only existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work; preserve all unknowns and reject vanity metrics as financial proof.
